# xkcd-mcp

> FastMCP 3.4 server: xkcd comic metadata via **xkcd.com** official `info.0.json` plus explanations, transcripts, trivia, and topic search via **explainxkcd.com** MediaWiki JSON API (no HTML page scraping). Dual transport: **stdio** default, **HTTP** with MCP at `/mcp`. Optional Vite dashboard on **10779** proxied to the API on **10778**.

**Full detail:** see [`llms-full.txt`](llms-full.txt).

## Quick links

- [README](README.md) — install, run, tool table
- [CHANGELOG](CHANGELOG.md)
- [glama.json](glama.json) — Glama discovery

## Tools

- **`xkcd_latest`** — Fetch current comic (optional `include_explanation=True`).
- **`xkcd_get`** — Fetch specific comic by number (optional `include_explanation=True`).
- **`xkcd_explain`** — Fetch explainxkcd explanation, transcript, and trivia for any comic (defaults to latest).
- **`xkcd_search`** — Search comics by topic via explainxkcd MediaWiki search.
- **`xkcd_random`** — Surprise random comic (optional `include_explanation=True`).
- **`show_comic_prefab_card`** — Render rich in-chat Prefab card.
- **`xkcd_help`** — Rich help card & port info.

## Ports (fleet range 10700–10800)

| Role | Port |
|------|------|
| FastAPI + MCP HTTP | **10778** |
| Vite dev (SPA) | **10779** |

Adjacency: backend/frontend paired per fleet **WEBAPP_STANDARDS** (see local `mcp-central-docs` clone if present).
